statusLine.command:
input=$(cat)
cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty')
[ -z "$cwd" ] && cwd="$PWD"
dir="${cwd/#$HOME/~}"
model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty')
used=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty')
user=$(whoami)
host=$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname)
git_seg=""
branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then
  dirty=""
  if ! git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
    dirty=" ✚"
  fi
  gbg=64
  [ -n "$dirty" ] && gbg=136
  git_seg=$(printf '\033[48;5;%sm\033[38;5;255m ⎇ %s%s \033[0m' "$gbg" "$branch" "$dirty")
fi
ctx=""
if [ -n "$used" ]; then
  ctx=$(printf ' · %.0f%%' "$used")
fi
printf '\033[48;5;236m\033[38;5;250m %s@%s \033[0m\033[48;5;24m\033[38;5;255m %s \033[0m%s\033[48;5;239m\033[38;5;255m %s%s \033[0m\n' "$user" "$host" "$dir" "$git_seg" "$model" "$ctx"
